caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, metallic object with a flat, bronze-colored surface and stepped edges at the base. On the top surface, there is a circular ring handle attached to a base plate, located toward one corner. Along one of the shorter edges, two small, dark-colored protruding elements are visible, possibly buttons or switches. The main object is set against a light beige background, and the entire scene is bordered by a simple, thin, rectangular outline. In the lower right corner inside the border, there is a small inset diagram showing a simplified line drawing of the object with dimensions marked as “5” and “8” along the sides. Handwritten text at the bottom left reads "Edward L. Lopez, Del 2549."
title: Brass Box Lock
